title: S4-FX-05 — Cleanup keeps protected details.
goal: Cleanup finds a detached stray pixel without changing anything while it scans, Apply removes only that pixel, and Undo restores the exact marked artwork. The drawing comes from a replay link: a filled 10×10 ellipse plus one detached gray pixel at (0,0).

steps.why: The replay draws exactly the ellipse and one stray.
The scan reports the detached pixel as a stray.
Only the stray is removed; the ellipse is intact.
Undo restores the exact marked artwork.
